about.text: A raw cow's-milk cheese from Savoie, cylindrical, 40 to 50 cm across and 8 to 12 cm high, 5 to 12 kg. It is semi-cooked and persillé (blue-veined), and was traditionally a lean family cheese tied to butter-making.

sources.text: Raw cow's milk, semi-cooked persillé, size and weight, and its role as a lean family cheese.
